title: Benchmark Option D implementation + DI-25-02 guard_consistent root cause + LLM reviews + S5 first run

dependencies.reason: Agents C+D complete, wave_4_results.json written, DI-24-03 Option D approved. change_manifest_session_25.json status=COMPLETED required.

critical_notes: E1: source_ref wins over spec if they conflict. E4: Python null discipline in compare.py changes. E5: no scope expansion.

DI-24-03 OPTION D is approved: benchmark reads gate output. TP = CONFIRMED or PLAUSIBLE in validated_findings that match GT. FP = CONFIRMED/PLAUSIBLE that do not match GT. UNCERTAIN = undecided (in DR denominator, not TP/FP). ACCEPTED_FP = correctly rejected (not in denominator). Implement in benchmark/compare.py.
DI-25-02 root cause is UNKNOWN — do not assume. Read phase3_gate.py guard_consistent logic, read one of the failing backwpup TP findings, trace why guard_consistent=false. Only then fix or document.
DI-25-03: phase3_summary.accepted_fp=0 in gate JSON — fix in phase3_gate.py by counting from validated_findings before writing summary. Simple count fix, low risk.
WAVE4-LLM-REVIEW: cartflows has 6 UNCERTAIN findings, pretty-link has 1. Run phase3_llm_review.py for both. Backwpup review is partial (12/22) — consider re-run with longer timeout if time permits.
S5-FIRST-RUN: only after benchmark is stable (DI-24-03 implemented, wave_4_results updated). Run S5 on backwpup (2 GT findings). Document whether S5 confirms, misses, or downgrades any finding.

files_to_read.reason: Verify session 25 complete; read discovered_issues for DI-25-01/02/03 context
DI-24-03: understand current logic before implementing Option D. Key: where is verdict read, where is TP/FP determined.
DI-25-02 + DI-25-03: trace guard_consistent rule and find where phase3_summary is written to fix accepted_fp field.
DI-25-02: read a failing UNCERTAIN finding to understand why guard_consistent=false. Look at guard_consistent_details if present.

DI-24-03.change: Implement Option D: read phase3.final.json (or phase3.json if final missing) for each plugin. TP = validated_findings where validation_status in (CONFIRMED, PLAUSIBLE) and finding matches GT by sink file+line (existing matching logic). FP = CONFIRMED/PLAUSIBLE with no GT match. UNCERTAIN = undecided (counted in DR denominator as unresolved, not TP or FP). ACCEPTED_FP = correctly rejected, not counted in denominator. DR denominator = TP + FP + FN + UNCERTAIN. After implementing: re-run benchmark, update wave_4_results.json.
DI-24-03.note: source_ref wins. If compare.py structure conflicts with this spec, adapt to match the Option D semantics described in the user approval message in session 25.

DI-25-02.change: Investigate guard_consistent rule. Read the gate code for guard_consistent. Read a backwpup UNCERTAIN finding to see guard_consistent_details. Identify root cause (wrong file path, wrong function name lookup, or logic bug). Only fix if root cause is clear and fix is <10 lines. Otherwise document root cause in change_manifest and defer fix to session 27.
DI-25-02.note: Do NOT assume the fix. Investigate first.

DI-25-03.change: Fix phase3_summary.accepted_fp: after gate assigns validation_status to all validated_findings, count findings with validation_status=ACCEPTED_FP and write that count to phase3_summary.accepted_fp. Same pattern as existing confirmed/uncertain counts in the summary block.
DI-25-03.note: Low risk, mechanical fix. Verify by re-running gate for one plugin and checking phase3_summary.accepted_fp > 0.

WAVE4-LLM-REVIEW.change: Run phase3_llm_review.py for cartflows (6 UNCERTAIN) and pretty-link (1 UNCERTAIN). Use provider=claude, model=claude-sonnet-4.6, timeout=0 (disabled). After review completes, run phase3_apply_review.py for each. Update wave_4_results.json with LLM review status.
WAVE4-LLM-REVIEW.note: Backwpup partial review (12/22): if time permits, re-run with timeout=0. But only after cartflows+pretty-link are done.

S5-FIRST-RUN.change: Run S5 on backwpup after DI-24-03 is implemented and benchmark is re-run. Read skill-set-verify.md first to understand expected input/output format. Run S5, document: findings S5 confirms, findings S5 misses, whether S5 changes gate outcome. Update wave_4_results.json S5 status.
S5-FIRST-RUN.note: Only run S5 after benchmark Option D is stable. If S5 output format is incompatible with pipeline state, document blocker and defer.
